title: Issue-linked radial-binning and power-accumulation witness for NeuralOperator spectrum_2d

source_case_schema.source_function: small discrete Fourier modes with known radial wavenumbers and complex coefficients

parameters.power_metric: sum of squared magnitudes within a bin

transformation_preconditions: The subject is a 2D spectral diagnostic whose bins are interpreted radially.
Wavenumber coordinates are available as integer grid modes.
Spectral coefficients are available before radial aggregation.
The external issue and merged PR document the L2-radius and power-order semantic correction.

boundary_condition_compatibility.reason: NeuralOperator issue #532 and PR #661 document that spectrum_2d should use L2 wavenumber radius and should square magnitudes before summing within bins.

output_mapping.description: Compare old L1-radius binning with corrected L2-radius binning, and old square-after-complex-sum power with corrected sum-of-squared-magnitudes power.

exclusion_rules: Exclude claims about trained NeuralOperator or FNO model accuracy.
Exclude claims about defect prevalence in NeuralOperator.
Exclude spectra whose binning semantics are intentionally non-radial.
Exclude hardware-specific FFT artifact claims; this card covers only the issue/PR #532/#661 utility semantics.

verdict_interpretation.pass: The issue/PR artifacts are present and the witness reproduces both the L1/L2 radial-binning contrast and the power-accumulation order contrast.
verdict_interpretation.fail: The artifact checks or metric contrasts contradict the issue/PR-linked semantic correction.
verdict_interpretation.skip: The run was not executed because source artifacts were unavailable.
verdict_interpretation.out-of-relation-domain: The target spectrum is not a radial 2D spectrum or does not aggregate spectral power.
verdict_interpretation.numerical-tolerance-issue: Floating-point tolerance dominates the small spectral contrast.
verdict_interpretation.inconclusive: The external issue/PR link or semantic witness evidence is incomplete.

claim_limitations: This MR card supports one external issue/PR-linked spectral-metric semantic witness for a NeuralOperator utility function. It does not report trained-FNO accuracy, NeuralOperator-wide correctness, production workload behavior, or a real-world defect-detection rate.
